Get Max Edge Count Between Sets (Fixed Degree Sequence)

get_edge_count_between_max_fds.Rd

Calculates the maximum possible number of edges between two disjoint sets of vertices, given their prescribed degrees (Fixed Degree Sequence model).

Usage

get_edge_count_between_max_fds(object, set1, set2)

# S4 method for class 'ECGraph'
get_edge_count_between_max_fds(object, set1, set2)

Arguments

object

An ECGraph object.

set1

A character vector of vertex names.

set2

A character vector of vertex names.

Value

The maximum possible number of edges, while preserving vertex degrees.

Methods (by class)

  • get_edge_count_between_max_fds(ECGraph): Method for ECGraph objects.

Examples

# Bipartite graph example
edge_df <- data.frame(p1=c("A","A","B"), p2=c("X","Y","Y"))
ecg <- ECGraph(edge_df)
get_edge_count_between_max_fds(ecg, c("A","B"), c("X","Y")) # Returns 3
#> [1] 3
